description: Cyber-Physical Systems Approach for the Optimal Design in Wind Engineering: Parapet Walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Brian Phillips, University of Florida (ufl.edu). The research objective of this project is to develop a cyber-physical systems (CPS) approach to the optimal design of structures for wind hazards. The approach combines the accuracy of physical wind tunnel testing with the efficiency of numerical optimization algorithms to create an efficient approach to structural design. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-p8wj-ey61. Keywords: cyber-physical systems, mechatronic, optimization, boundary layer wind tunnel. Published 2019-10-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
